chemotaxis-motility/kstrail.note: Crescent swimmers form spontaneously from noise (spot -> ring -> rupture -> crescent). The chi_h=0 ablation gives static spots. Passes dt/2 and 2x resolution with no heading lock. The swimmer phase coarsens to immotile aggregates by t=1800. L3 Weak (wake, not membrane). Known drift-bifurcation physics.

chemotaxis-motility/ecology.note: Prey-predator pairs, contact 0.93-0.96 vs null ~0.33 (4 seeds). Predators fall 93-95% at k=0 (2 seeds). In matched reruns prey do better WITH predators: an obligate escort or parasite, not demonstrated predation. No cycles. Provisional pending the matched decomposition.

chemotaxis-motility/toxforage.note: Toxic self-waste acts as size control and keeps 9-14 swimmers with turnover to t=1500. L4c Weak (near-Supported): the judge's n=0 fork kills every body within 200 t and kd=0 gives a sea, but on one seed only. L4a Weak.

chemotaxis-motility/pursuit.note: Non-reciprocal cross-taxis binds chaser-fleer composites (contact 0.76-0.91 vs null 0.27-0.31). A clean 2x2 ablation shows pursuit binds and evasion shapes the bond. L5 Weak: conserved species, so no population dynamics.

autopoiesis/phase_membrane.note: Forms from noise. Links adsorbed at the wall make an L ring 2.1-2.5x the core and about 0 outside (three judges' seed-11 profiles). Two judges traced divisions (to gen 3) in which both daughters carry a complete ring. 9-12 persistent splits (gen 2-3) in 3 seeds. dt/2 and 2x resolution keep the ring and gen 3. 35-41% cuts re-ring within 100-150 t against twins (2 seeds). Starvation fission with high fusion and mortality. The ring comes from a designed adsorption drift. A chi=0 control (load-bearing ring?) is pending.

autopoiesis/phase_swimdiv.note: The lab's first dividing swimmers. The planted cell splits 4-fold, and crescent daughters with depletion wakes divide again and again (10 and 5 divisions on judge seeds 11 and 12; segments up to 7.9 BL). Reproduces with an isotropic stencil. Propulsion is a hand-coded nonlocal per-body rigid drift. Headings cluster on lattice diagonals in some seeds. L3 Weak (no material membrane). labkit tracks break for swimmers.

autopoiesis/phase_protocell_noise.note: Walled droplets form from noise and divide by central starvation: 42-46 cells, 28-33 persistent splits, gen 3-4, in 3 seeds plus seed 11. dt/2 and 2x resolution match. The 'membrane' is 4phi(1-phi), a contour of phi, and L is a filled disk (wall/core about 1.1), so L3 is Weak. L4a is Weak (near-Supported): 3/3 round cells healed to their twins' area, on one seed. Close to Gray-Scott mitosis and Zwicker droplets.

autopoiesis/phase_kinds.note: A faster K2 mutant replaces K1 in 3/3 seeds plus seed 11, and divisions breed true. But the sweep is mostly contagion: 45 intact K1 cells converted without division against 8 mutations, K2 still swept with mutation off, and K1 cells had 0 deaths vs 174 for K2. L7 Weak. The parasite variant (extinction above a threshold) reads best as an infection model.

autopoiesis/phase_trait.note: Heritable growth-rate trait: means drift toward about 0.16-0.18 from both starts (3+3 seeds) but have not converged and have overlapping bands. No neutral control, the trait is invisible in the sheets, and the population is frozen after about 12k. L7 Weak.

fisim-beyond-laplacian/xcell-turn.note: RETRACTED by the researcher in r2, and withdrawn as the family's L6 evidence. The waste was gated by cargo through a channel-index bug, and every founder was planted with q=1.2. Its gen 5/6/4 is colonization of a box emptied by poisoned founders, by 2 survivors, not turnover. With m-gated waste the world goes extinct by t~32. Superseded by xcell-evo2.

fisim-beyond-laplacian/xcell-a.note: m4 gliders (8/8 cells, 7.9-8.6 body lengths, 3 seeds) with a band-deposited membrane ring (m 0.55 at the rim, 0.22 at the centre, ~0 outside). The ring holds a fast D=4 cargo: 1.24 at the centre vs 0.43 with the gate off, dt-converged. The body is exactly m4 (K=0), so the compartment is passive. Part of the m field is a trailing wake. L4a Weak: one cell, 29.6% erased. Unchanged in sprint 2. Biologist dissent from r1: L3 Weak.

fisim-beyond-laplacian/xcell-her.note: Two planted kinds breed true: 46 divisions in r1, 0 mixed, 0 switches. Removing the membrane gate on h erases every on-lineage while body and division are unchanged (3 judges). kb -10% breaks it. Sprint-2 arm L (ungated, Dh=0.02) loses all markers by t~100, reproduced by the skeptic on seed 11 at 64². The ungated fronts are ~1 px wide and blocky, though, so this is not yet a matched Laplacian control. Kick-arisen markers in xcell-evo2 bred true in 0 of 3 divisions, so heredity is shown only for planted, cell-filling domains. L6 Weak (one counted generation). L7 Contradicted.

fisim-beyond-laplacian/xcell-div.note: Membrane-ringed cells divide by Gray-Scott-class RD (8 splits even with the gate off): 13/15/15 splits, then a frozen lattice under a global cap by t~200. L6 Weak (max gen 2 from planted founders). Passes dt/2 and dx 0.33. A single-seed noise screen forms ~26 ringed cells.

flow-lenia/fl_forager.note: One 12x12 noise patch becomes 8-14 motile crescent foragers with food-depletion wakes, with 0 nucleations in 4 seeds (3 packs plus skeptic seed 11). 2-generation chains appear in seeds 1, 2 and 11 (labkit gen 3 on seed 11). Propulsion is emergent: the parent rule glides without food. Behaviour survives 2x resolution, but crescents become ring-in-halo shapes there. Fission-fusion: merges are about 80% of splits, so lineages are reticulate (biologist dissent: L6 Weak). L4c Weak (one-seed screen; dependence built in by the decay k_dec). Selection not detected.

flow-lenia/fl_cells.note: Noise patches condense into 3-channel cells: an A0 core, a 1.5-px A1 ring that is 0 inside and outside, and A2 shells. Radii agree at 2x resolution (skeptic). 38-44% cuts re-form ring and crown against twins in 3 seeds, but the cells end smaller with a hollow core (generic re-condensation; mass is closed). Static, one cell per planted patch, and the beaded crown is numerical (gone at dt/2). Close to the Particle Lenia control.

flow-lenia/fl_morph257.note: One patch sorts into orange A1 rings and cyan A0 crescents that multiply with 0 nucleations. Crescents cup rings for 500-650 t, and a cyan ring encloses orange cells and reopens. 20/30 composite divisions give one of each kind, and pure parents divide true 5/6. One seed, so L5, L4b and L6 are Weak. Composition heredity is partly built into uptake proportional to A_c.

flow-lenia/fl_forager_mut.note: Parameter-localized foragers with body-scale mutations: 62 mutations, phylogeny depth 7, and new morphs persist (a compact solid body; a target-ring cell). A neutral twin replaying the same events with mut_size 0 shows as much clade turnover (root share 9% vs 36%), on one pair. Fusion dominates (177 splits vs 169 merges, gen 0). L6 and L7 Weak. The 40-run founder tournament (fl_forager_evo) was a coin flip.

flow-lenia/fl_cells_food.note: Layered cells eat, turn binucleate and form a 6-8-compartment 'morula' (t about 1040-1200), then A1 dots tile the domain. There are 257 nucleations, and A0/A2 are down 99.8%/97.6% before the 'spores' appear, so they condense from shed matter rather than budding. L6[L3] Contradicted; L3 Weak (transient). One seed. A striking movie.

particle-life/sporecell.note: Forms spontaneously from ~20 random catalyst particles in a closed food gas. Ringed founders shed single-particle spores while staying intact, and the spores grow into 34-40 parent-size daughters per seed. The population then freezes into a ~40-cell lattice set by the B shell (3 seeds; the skeptic's seed-11 rerun ends with 39 cells against 38-41). L3 Weak: the one-particle M ring is a food-contact label that every cell loses at depletion (t~146-157) while the cells live about 100 t longer, and cells form and reproduce without it (L_nomem). L6[L2] Weak: gen 2 is 8/1/1, and deeper counts come from a fragment/re-merge ratchet in lineage.py. L4a Weak: the cut turns debris into food at the wound, and labkit's disk cut shattered the cell. L4c Weak: one seed, R2=1 variant, and the decline equals the imposed decay. No dt check.

particle-life/sporecell-gene.note: Kind 1 arises by mutation and ends as the majority in 7/10, 11/11 and 6/11 cells, against 3/9, 0/9 and 1/10 for a neutral mutant (3 seeds). This is selection among particles inside cells, through two-sector Janus cells, not heredity between cells. L7 Contradicted: purity 0.55-0.88, parent-child agreement 0.58-0.93. The gen-9 lineage is a staircase of fragments. The evidence is in screens at mu=0.01, while the pack runs at mu=0.002.

particle-life/plife-m2.note: Known Mohr/Ventrella particle-life cells, used as calibration. Concentric type-sorted shells (white on a green core, pink on cyan) form from random types by t~3.5 and persist to t=80 in 3 seeds. One random matrix, a short run, and no dt check. The raster cannot resolve the shells. labkit flags movers at 8.9-13.2 BL that have not been examined (an L4b lead).

lenia-multichannel/mcfd-MIRd.note: Planted MIRd+ fed by regrowing food with maintenance decay 0.03. labkit reads gen 0 (K=10% of run). A judge's dense rerun of seed 2 shows two binary fissions after a trough (4->17 cells in ~100 t), with daughters re-forming core, cap and dots. Food competition sets the dynamics (no food: fills the grid; norefill: extinct; decay 0/0.01/0.03: dormant/static/boom-bust). The 'regular cycle' is not robust: peak spacing 530/290/260, a ~650 t static plateau on seed 11, troughs of 2 cells, damped at 192², extinct at dt/2 in 1/2 seeds. L3 Weak (1-2 px halo dots).

lenia-multichannel/mcf-MIRd.note: Chan's planted replicator with build-from-food: 6 persistent splits, gen 3 (seeds 0 and 2). Norefill is extinct in 3/3 seeds by t~230-310, against 11-16 survivors with refill. L5 Weak: a single boom and decline in 400 t; long runs end in extinction or a dormant lattice. Replication itself is Chan's result (no-food control reaches gen 4).

lenia-multichannel/mcf-fastcell.note: Planted Chan 'fast cell' gliders (8-15 BL, 3 seeds plus seed 11) carve food wakes. A radial profile shows a real A0 shell at r 14-22 with A0=0 inside r<8. Norefill leaves 0/0/1 survivors vs 3/4/3. Spontaneity 0. Baseline attrition without food. No dt/R test.

lenia-multichannel/r-two56.note: One of 2/420 random 2-channel rules: cells with a white centre, cyan core and orange cog shell form from noise (3 pack seeds plus 3 judge seeds) and stay unchanged to t=400-500. dt/2 from noise keeps 6 cells. Formed cells survive R=15 and R=20 with the same ~10 teeth. Static fixed points with no turnover. Narrow island (1/5 jitter draws). L4a Contradicted (core damage kills).

lenia-multichannel/r-two-s1-60.note: C-gliders peel off a jammed crowd of ~45 bodies that forms from noise (3.0-3.8 BL). The second channel is dead by t~2-6 and constant-k5 keeps the glider, so this is the known single-channel Lenia class. Grid-aligned bricks. L5 Weak (jamming shown by one planting test).

active-droplets/ad5-evolve.note: The lab's first L7 to pass the contagion audit. All 3 judges checked seed 11: every living-droplet conversion traces to a same-allele mutation patch, destinations are unbiased, and there are 0 deaths and 0 merges. Divisions by allele [a0..a3] = [0,0,2,4]; an ancestor-matched neutral (all k=0.10) has 0 divisions. Over 6+6 seeds (biologist), fast alleles a2+a3 number 10,6,9,9,9,7 vs 2,1,3,4,3,4 under neutral, and the a1<a2<a3 ordering appears under selection only. Minimal: the ancestor is sterile, and the shipped neutral arm is unmatched (k=0.13 vs 0.10). Mutation is a 5-px half-droplet transplant (flips >= divisions), and 1-2 of 6 divisions give an off-kind daughter. About 6 divisions and 12 droplets per run, all during colonization, then a frozen lattice.

active-droplets/ad3-membrane (+ ad3s-sou.note: A self-made amphiphile shell in its own channel. psi is 0.18 in the core, 0.82-0.95 at the interface and about 0.05 outside (2 judges' seed-11 profiles). The shell lines both faces of the ring stage, wraps every daughter, forms from psi=0 in 9/9 runs including random-blob soups, and fills the body at chi=0. It is inert (s=0, no back-reaction; s=0.3 blows up), 98% explained by |grad phi|^2 + c, and 1-2 px wide with no resolution test. The same drift rings RD spots without CH. Division is ad1's (gen 2-4 in 3 seeds; gen 2 on 2 judge reruns). L4a Weak: a 44% side chop heals into one cell, and a 52% central wound kills (1 seed). Skeptic dissent: L3 Weak.

active-droplets/ad1-fuel.note: Planted disks hollow into rings that break up. The fragments then divide by dumbbell pinch for 2 rounds (lineage gen 2-4, 12-16 persistent splits) and end in a static lattice of about 18 droplets. Three judges' seed-11 reruns match. dt/2 and dx=0.5 converge. This is Gray-Scott mitosis in a Cahn-Hilliard body: Laplacian-only twins (D=0.015, and Dv=M=0.03) also hollow and divide, while D=0.06 gives static spots. L4c Weak (global F=0 only). Uniform starts go extinct.

active-droplets/ad4-protocell.note: Two planted catalyst kinds with the inert ad3 shell. They breed true (mixed=0), but max gen is 2 from directly dividing founders in all 3 seeds (L6 Weak), and the population is frozen by t~8000. The kind difference (A 3->6, B 3->5) is within noise. Superseded by ad5.

fisim-beyond-laplacian/xcell-evo2-S.note: Selection experiment, arms S and N: identical-event twins (kicks and dilution from one shared RNG), 3+3 seeds, T=2000. L6: S0 reaches gen 6 (11 persistent splits, 0 merges) and N1 gen 4. The biologist's merge-aware movie tracker and birth crops confirm clean rod->dumbbell->two ringed daughters in the S0 chain (t=450/510/570/960). Only 2/6 runs reach gen>=3 by labkit, the bodies are planted, every death is an imposed disk erasure, and division is Gray-Scott-class. L7 Contradicted: on->on+on 0 in 6 runs, and all 3 on-divisions (2 independent kicks) were on->on+off, by polar segregation of a fresh kick. Final on-cells S 1/0/2 vs N 1/1/0. About 0.7 dilution generations per run, so the test is underpowered. L3 rests on the band ring plus r1 gate ablations, which were not repeated in evo2.
